---
title: "Resource Library"
---

Welcome to the Resource Library. This section should become the practical knowledge hub of the site, where visitors can quickly find resources connected to RDA, FAIR data, and domain-specific needs.

## What This Library Should Eventually Support

- Featured resources for priority domains
- Filtering by domain, topic, type, language, and audience
- Clear links to RDA outputs, recommendations, and external materials
- Short descriptions explaining why each resource is useful

## Featured Starter Categories

### Documents and Guides
- [RDA Global Website](https://www.rd-alliance.org/)
- Data Management Plan templates
- Practical guides for metadata, interoperability, and repository selection

### Training and Video
- Webinar: Introduction to RDA
- Tutorial: Setting up your first data repository
- Short explainers for domain communities and newcomers

### RDA and Community Links
- [RDA Global Website](https://www.rd-alliance.org/)
- [Find a Working Group](https://www.rd-alliance.org/groups/)
- [RDA for Disciplines](https://www.rd-alliance.org/disciplines/)

## Example Curation Model

Each resource entry can later include:

- Title
- Format
- Domain
- Topic
- Audience
- Source or owner
- External link
- Short summary

## Suggested Priority Resource Collections

- Getting started with FAIR data
- RDA outputs relevant to your target domains
- Training materials and slide decks
- Use cases, case studies, and adoption stories

---
*In a next phase, this library can be dynamically generated from a central data file to allow filtering, sorting, and easier maintenance.*
